text:
andrea: Heads-up: saw a perf regression after yesterday's kernel selector change. p50 token latency up ~12% on /v1/generate for gpt-x-8q in eu-west.
sam: ugh. can you paste the query and a quick flame?
andrea: query and short summary below. flame attached in thread.

andrea: PromQL that flagged it: `histogram_quantile(0.5, sum(rate(redwood_runtime_token_latency_ms_bucket{route="/v1/generate",model="gpt-x-8q"}[2m])) by (le, kernel_version, quant_profile, route))`

maria: I think the new kernel selector introduced `kernel_variant` labels with instance-specific ids — huge cardinality. we shouldn't have instance identifiers on high-card metrics.

devon: confirmed. the kernel selector added `kernel_variant=nv_1a_0x7f` for debugging. metric explosion looks like the cause.

andrea: aside from dropping that label, we should also break down token latency into decode/kv/fwd so dashboards can point to where time is spent. current token metric is monolithic and hides KV waits.

sam: agree. propose new label set for the token-level histogram: `{route, model, model_version, kernel_family, kernel_semver, quant_profile, stage}` where stage in {decode, kv_fetch, kernel_exec}. drop any host/instance ids.

maria: +1 on stage buckets. also suggest naming convention: `redwood_runtime_token_latency_ms` (histogram) and version it like `redwood_runtime_token_latency_ms_v2` when we change labels. that avoids silent breaks in dashboards.

devon: on cardinality limits: for prometheus we should add relabel rules in scrapers to drop `kernel_variant` and `request_id` for metrics with `__name__=~"redwood_runtime_.*"`.

andrea: plan: 1) add relabel to drop debugging labels (hotfix), 2) publish new metric v2 with cleaned labels + stage breakdown, 3) migrate dashboards and alerting (canary test on /v1/generate), 4) deprecate v1 after 2 weeks.

sam: who owns step 2 (instrumentation)? I can take a PR for the runtime changes if someone writes the spec.
maria: I'll draft the spec in the observability repo: outline label sets, allowed cardinality per label, and examples of queries. will include notes about quant_profile normalization (e.g., "8bit-q4_0" -> "q4_0").

devon: for dashboards: add a per-route KPI panel with token-rate, p50/p95/p99 token-latency, and a stacked bar of stage latency (decode/kv/kernel). version dashboards with a `metrics_schema` variable.

andrea: also add an automated check in CI: on merged instrumentation changes, run a synthetic load that records per-label cardinality and fails if > threshold (configurable), to prevent regressions like this.

sam: ops-bot, can you schedule a quick rollback window for the kernel-selector change if hotfix relabeling doesn't ship in an hour?

ops-bot: scheduled rollback window: 1752202800 - 1752206400. paging list: @infra-oncall.

andrea: action items: maria write spec + PR, sam implement runtime labels PR, devon update Grafana variables, andrea do canary and telemetry checks. I'll open a tracking ticket.

maria: thanks. I'll ping here when the spec PR is up.

sam: thanks all. short-term fix first (drop kernel_variant) then the longer schema/versioning work.

andrea: :thumbsup:
